cover_fields.explanatoryNotes: Itau USA Asset Management, Inc. (IUAM) is an investment adviser based in New York City and registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission since 2011. IUAM submits its quarterly 13F Report filing in conjunction with other units within the Itau global conglomerate under the name of Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. Consistent with the quarterly 13F Report filing, the 13F Registrant Name listed above is Itau Unibanco Holding S.A., not IUAM. The address provided above is the official address for Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. and the 13F File Number, CIK identifier and CCC identifier are associated with the quarterly 13F Reports submitted under the name of Itau Unibanco Holding S.A.IUAM has engaged Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) to act as IUAM's proxy voting agent. The IUAM Compliance team manages the firm's relationship with ISS. Therefore, the Submission Contact Information and the Signatory Information provide the name and contact information for Dean Reiche, Vice President of Compliance for IUAM. Mr. Reiche is an authorized signatory of IUAM.
